## Personality

Bertha Harcourt possesses a talent for writing delightful and graceful letters. Her correspondence reflects her sweet and pleasing character through its phrasing and ideas.

## History

Bertha Harcourt enjoyed a courtship with Edmund [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) during which they were rarely apart. Following their wedding, where their deep mutual devotion was widely remarked upon, she shared a brief but tremendously happy marriage with him before her early death. Shortly before she died, she wrote a postscript about her baby, which was later discovered by her daughter [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) among a bundle of preserved letters in her former home.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P19](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0019), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020), [v3 ch.Yesterday P21](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0021)_

## Relationships

### [Edmund](../character/edmund.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/bertha-harcourt--edmund.md)

Bertha was married to Edmund until her death. Their deep affection for one another survived through a collection of intimate letters that remained in their former [Harborough](../codex/places.md#harborough) home long after their passing.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), +2 more_

- Spouse of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/bertha-harcourt--nell-harcourt.md)

Bertha was the mother of [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who was born in the east room of their [Harborough](../codex/places.md#harborough) home. Although Bertha passed away during Nell's youth, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) later visited her mother's grave and read her surviving love letters, finally feeling a deep connection to her late parents.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), +2 more_

- Parent of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)</sub>
